Guess and test model

Source: R/model-guess_and_test.R
guess_and_test.Rd

Trueswell & Gleitman 2011 guess-and-test model

Usage

guess_and_test(f, sa)

Arguments

f

forget at retrieval

sa

prob of storage (slow learning down)

Value

An object of class xslMod

Examples

mod <- guess_and_test(f = .1, sa = .5)
xsl_run(mod, get_example_ambiguous_condition())
